name: Naoe Kagekiyo
source: Yamato's father. Taught Yamato quite a few tricks. After giving up on Japan, he and his wife went to Europe to work as "merchants", buying and dealing with companies in/close to bankruptcy. Sometimes their deals are called "suspicious", but its probably because Kagekiyo's tactics to trick his targets and sometimes he seems cold to even his family.[spoiler] In  Margit's route Kagekiyo says to Yamato he made Saki his by "Showing his true feelings by fucking her" and has a master/slave relationship much stronger than Yamato in any route. [/spoiler] Despite all this, his love towards Saki and Yamato is real, and strong.
